document.title: Single source for native globals and a typed reconciler host config
document.summary: Each native global is declared once, a script checks the declared names against `src/jslib`, the runtime reuses the SDK's manifest type, the reconciler host config is typed without a cast, and `ButtonProps`/`ImageProps` derive from the host prop types.
document.why: The native JS contract was declared three times and had drifted, nothing checked it against the C registrations, and the host config cast hid missing reconciler methods that only fail on device ([#56](source:s1)).

sources.title: Single source of truth for native globals and a typed reconciler host config
sources.gist: Deduplicate native global declarations, check them against src/jslib, reuse the manifest type, remove the host config cast, Omit key for Button/Image props.

lookFor: Done differently: [#56](source:s1) proposes one `.d.ts` in the runtime that the SDK narrows. The SDK is published and the runtime is private, so the SDK keeps the author globals in `deck-app-globals.d.ts` and `runtime-native.d.ts` references them and adds only the runtime-only contract.

Done differently: [#56](source:s1) calls the manifest checks in `main.tsx` a re-validation. The checks stay; only the duplicate type goes, because the persisted Active Deck App is not re-validated natively at startup.

groups.title: One declaration per native global
groups.why: The runtime's copy of the author globals had drifted from the SDK's ([#56](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `runtime-native.d.ts` references `@vitadeck/sdk/deck-app-env` for console, timers, `getTime` and `fetch`, and `fetch.ts` drops its copies of the `Vita*` fetch types in favour of those globals.
lookFor: Subtle: the runtime now sees `console.info`/`console.warn` and `setTimeout`/`clearTimeout`, which `log.c` and `timeout.c` always registered; the SDK file the authors get is unchanged.

groups.title: Native globals check in CI
groups.why: Nothing compared the declarations with the names `src/jslib` registers ([#56](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `check-native-globals.ts` regex-reads `js_set_global_function` names and the declared functions, runs as `test:native-globals` in CI, and is typechecked by the root `tsc` script through `scripts/tsconfig.json`.
lookFor: The check is one-way for non-`native` names: a registered name must be declared (except the `log*` functions `console` wraps), but only declared `native*` names must be registered.

groups.title: Shared Deck App Package Manifest type
groups.why: `main.tsx` re-declared the manifest and had lost `images` ([#56](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `DeckAppPackageManifest` lives in the SDK, the CLI's written manifest `satisfies` it, and `main.tsx` imports it from `@vitadeck/sdk/internal`.

groups.title: Host config without the unknown cast
groups.why: The cast hid missing `HostConfig` members, which surface only as `is not a function` on device ([#56](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `rawHostConfig` now `satisfies VitadeckHostConfig`, so the ten required members it lacked are implemented and `Reconciler(hostConfig)` needs no cast.
lookFor: `scheduleTimeout` wraps `fn` in a void callback for the native `setTimeout`, and `getCurrentEventPriority` returns `DefaultEventPriority`; the root is created in legacy mode, so React does not ask for an event priority today.
`hideInstance`/`unhideInstance` stay unimplemented: they are optional in the types and the host has no way to hide an instance, so a Suspense fallback still throws.

groups.title: ButtonProps and ImageProps from host prop types
groups.why: `ButtonProps` duplicated `VitaButtonProps` and `ImageProps` still allowed `key`, unlike Rect, Text and Scroll ([#56](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `ButtonProps` is `Omit<VitaButtonProps, "key">` and `ImageProps` uses a distributive `OmitKey` so the width/height union survives.
lookFor: Subtle: a plain `Omit<VitaImageProps, "key">` would accept `{ x, y, image }` with neither `width` nor `height`; `OmitKey` keeps rejecting it.

commits.subject: refactor(sdk): derive ButtonProps and ImageProps from the host prop types
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
ButtonProps duplicated VitaButtonProps; it is now Omit<..., "key"> like
Rect, Text and Scroll. ImageProps uses a distributive Omit so the
width/height union keeps rejecting an image with neither.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(runtime): type the reconciler host config without a cast
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The host config was cast through unknown, hiding ten required HostConfig
members. They are now implemented: getPublicInstance returns the
instance, timeouts use the native timers, getCurrentEventPriority
returns DefaultEventPriority, and the DOM-only event handle and scope
hooks are inert.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(sdk): share the Deck App Package Manifest type with the runtime
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The runtime re-declared the manifest shape and had drifted (no images).
The SDK now owns DeckAppPackageManifest, the CLI's written manifest
satisfies it, and the runtime imports it from @vitadeck/sdk/internal.
The runtime keeps its checks: the persisted Active Deck App is not
re-validated natively at startup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: test(js): check declared native globals against src/jslib registrations
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
scripts/check-native-globals.ts reads js_set_global_function names from
src/jslib/*.c and fails when one is undeclared or a declared native*
function is never registered. Runs as test:native-globals in CI; the
script is typechecked by the root tsc script.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(runtime): layer native globals on the SDK's author globals
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
runtime-native.d.ts re-declared console, timers, getTime and fetch, and
had drifted from the SDK's deck-app-env (no console.info/warn, no
setTimeout). It now references @vitadeck/sdk/deck-app-env and declares
only the runtime-only contract, and fetch.ts uses the shared Vita* types.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
